test_dataframe_replace_scalar: test DataFrame.replace() with scalar to_replace and scalar value to replace matching entries
test_dataframe_replace_list: test DataFrame.replace() with list of to_replace values and list of replacement values
test_dataframe_replace_dict: test DataFrame.replace() with dict to_replace mapping values to replacements per column
test_dataframe_replace_regex: test DataFrame.replace() with regex patterns to match and replace string values
test_dataframe_replace_nested_dict: test DataFrame.replace() with nested dict mapping column to inner dict of value replacements
